title: What If the Sun Became a Black Hole? #Shorts
description:
If the Sun instantly collapsed into a black hole of the exact same mass, Earth would not get sucked in. Because the gravitational pull remains completely identical, our planet would continue orbiting at the exact same distance. But without solar radiation, global temperatures would plummet to minus one hundred degrees in weeks, freezing the oceans into solid ice. Subscribe to SciBytes for more mind-bending science!
